topic: Seed Run Pipeline and Completion Criteria
evidence: 100/100 PASS receipts written across 29 complete seed runs (20260524a through 20260525ac). Seed runs are real executions of the framework against itself — not simulations. Each run executes a discrete task card through the full receipt chain. Naming: YYYYMMDD{letter} (a-z then aa-az). Receipts in .wabblespec/receipts/. L8 corpus gate cleared at run 20260525ac. Run durations ranged from single-module exercises to multi-wave builds. The 100-receipt corpus is the evidence base for L8 Instinct pattern detection. Instinct observed 117 receipts when patterns were detected (session receipts added during observation window).
